questions.text: Q-01: The ticket says "last visit" but the glossary doesn't define a visit. Appointments can be SCHEDULED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED or NO_SHOW. Which appointment counts as the patient's last visit?
Q-02: Should patients who have never visited (shown as "Never") be included when the "Not seen for a year" filter is on?
Q-03: How should "more than 12 months ago" be measured?
REQ-3: I assumed the "Last visit" column shows only the date (no time), as a hospital-local date in Asia/Kolkata, because the baseline sets the hospital time zone to Asia/Kolkata. Is that right?
Q-01: The stories test the last-visit date and doctor on each patient row. What shape should GET /api/patients return for it?
Q-02: What query parameter should turn on the "Not seen for a year" filter on GET /api/patients?
Q-03: How should the web page display the last-visit date? Note that the existing dateTime helper prints a time as well, so it doesn't fit a date-only value.

C14: I assumed the web patient list request goes through `api` in web/src/api/client.ts, which builds query strings with `query`, so the new filter flag is added there. Is that right? (implement must confirm the exact method)
